# Dependency pins applied on top of the pinned envoyproxy/gateway release
# (ENVOY_GATEWAY_VERSION) to remediate CVEs in the bundled image.
#
# Each entry is a minimum version. `go mod tidy` settles the rest, so modules
# that move only as a consequence -- x/mod and x/tools, pulled in by x/text --
# are not listed.
#
# golang.org/x/net v0.56.0 clears GO-2026-5942, a panic parsing an invalid SVCB
# or HTTPS DNS record in x/net/dns/dnsmessage. The pinned release still ships
# v0.55.0.
#
# golang.org/x/text v0.39.0 clears CVE-2026-56852 / GO-2026-5970, an infinite
# loop in norm.Iter on invalid UTF-8, reachable from gateway-api schema
# validation.
#
# github.com/docker/cli v29.6.0 was advanced by an earlier revision of this
# patch and the pinned release now satisfies it, so it produces no hunk. Kept
# declared so a regression re-emits it.
golang.org/x/net v0.56.0
golang.org/x/text v0.39.0
github.com/docker/cli v29.6.0
